scope: Diagnosis of private archived generation2_v4 only; no fresh champion inspected or implicated.

root_causes.finding: Routing accepts well-separated edge magnitudes as sufficient evidence that the clustered approximation is suitable, without bounding aggregate interblock interaction strength.
root_causes.evidence: All three strength-0.15 cases retain blocks of size 4/5/6/7 because selected edge-gap ratios are 5.38-6.42, above the cutoff 5, although interblock RMS is 0.139-0.155.

root_causes.finding: The block-factorized mean-field/local-mixture candidate is a poor approximation on these connected inputs. Exact global scoring already detects both large KL and low ESS, but there is no quality-based fallback.
root_causes.evidence: Returned cross-block weights are exactly zero in all three exact-match replays. choose_composition returns its best unsafe candidate when no candidate reaches internal ESS > 0.5.

root_causes.finding: The interaction-correction acceptance guard rejects substantially improved candidates that satisfy the registered ESS >= 0.25 gate, because its extra chi < 2 gate demands ESS > 0.5, then keeps the much worse unsafe original.
root_causes.evidence: Corrected candidates have KL 0.158-0.211 and ESS 0.405-0.490, all with lower selection objective, but final returned ESS remains 0.0129-0.0230.

root_causes.finding: The already-bundled old-champion fallback is reached only when a detected block exceeds nine spins, not when exact quality checks fail.
root_causes.evidence: The stronger interacting strength-0.4 and strength-0.8 cases collapse to a 20-site detected block and already route to this byte-identical old-champion code, explaining the nonmonotonic failure pattern.

fallback_assessment.answer: A coupling-only fallback can avoid all three catastrophic tail failures on this grid, but does not eliminate every KL > 0.04 diagnostic.
fallback_assessment.gate: For an input routed to the clustered path, use the old champion if RMS of all interblock couplings exceeds 0.10. Existing fallback cases stay unchanged.
fallback_assessment.interpretation: Post-hoc selection of existing measured old/v4 results, not a newly executed or preregistered hybrid. The gate selects exactly these three cases and uses no IDs, labels, or seeds. Two switched cases retain KL > 0.04; all three old-champion ESS values exceed 0.82. No generalization guarantee is claimed.

attribution: This is a routing/approximation/acceptance defect of the private v4 portfolio solver, not a resource failure, proof of an eight-component capacity limit, or evidence about a future fresh champion.
